title: Hidden Haven - comfy, cozy, & close to Nashville
description:
Our guesthouse provides not only  a place for rest and relaxation, but bikes for the trail,  an outdoor fireplace, hammocks, a pool in season(closed now), and so much more.  We are five minutes from  Providence shopping/dinning, 15 minutes from the airport BNA, just 20 minutes from downtown Nashville, and 20 minutes from the Opryland Hotel/Grand Ole Opry, plus two minutes from the best apple fritters in Tennessee!

The space
Our guest house is a stand alone 600 square feet private area for guests. It is  an open concept (studio) with a living space, kitchenette, and bedroom space with a king size bed. It can sleep 6 comfortably with queen size sofa bed, single sofa bed, queen floor mattress, and single floor mattress. It is an open floor plan . There is a partition in the Airbnb to allow for more privacy.

Guest access
In addition to the guest house, there is an outdoor fireplace and patio area. In the summer, there will be access to a pool. We have an entrance with steps a d one without steps.

Other things to note
-There is a work space in the Airbnb with free WiFi.
-We do not accommodate work crews.
-If you have more than one vehicle, please communicate that up front.
